sources.title: Press Information Department, PR No.138, Islamabad, September 19, 2023 (read with the issuer's RapidSSL intermediate added, verification on)
sources.said: Film and Drama Finance Fund was established on August 5, 2023 after the Rules for the Fund were notified. A seed money of Rs. 1 billion was initially allocated as Technical Supplementary Grant to establishthe said Fund. A Fund Management Committee comprising ex-officio members and members of film Fraternity was later notified by the Ministry to manage the Fund. The participants of the meeting appreciated Ministry's efforts for the inclusion of the Fund in the Thirteenth Schedule of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 that will enable the contributors to the fund, tax exemptions in similar manner as those granted to companies in the ambit of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).

figures.finding: Not searched this run. No production rebate exists in what was read; the 2018 policy names 'drama' throughout and proposes equipment duty and sales-tax relief and a fund offering loan mark-up subsidies. Whether the customs and sales-tax proposals were enacted in the Finance Act 2018 was not read (the PID release reports only the fund). The fund's 2023 rules were not found.

policy2018Proposals.financeFund: mark-up subsidy on bank loans for approved film and drama projects

inForce.fundInThirteenthScheduleITO2001: contributors get CSR-like tax exemptions (per the PID release)
